question: Is enriching training triples with local context subgraphs a novel approach, or have similar methods been proposed in the KGQA literature?
description: Determine whether the idea of adding local context from the same passage to triples has been explored before.
rationale: If similar methods exist, the contribution may be incremental; if not, the idea is novel.
resolution: No directly matching work was found in the analyzed literature; the closest works (e.g., arxiv:2110.12679, arxiv:2211.05351, doi:10.1109/ikt65497.2024.10892619) differ in focusing on architectural changes or retrieval-augmented generation rather than training data enrichment with local context subgraphs and adaptive repair loop.
